The fixture contains the original mathlib directory-dependency linter at commit `56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679`. This module imports Lean directly and compiles without a prebuilt Mathlib heap. The Apache 2.0 license accompanies the module. [Upstream source](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679/Mathlib/Tactic/Linter/DirectoryDependency.lean).
